title: POST /api/tasks randomly fails with a 500 before creating a task
summary: The POST handler in app/api/tasks/route.ts returns 500 about half the time (Math.random() < 0.5) before parsing the body, so task creation silently fails intermittently and the tests that create tasks flake on their list/counter assertions. The spec and the rest of the app logic are correct; the failure is nondeterministic with no relevant code change.
